value.rationale: The source identifies an apparently destructive infinite angular-speed variance in its 2D model. A general theorem shows this obstruction has a sharp geometric dimension boundary under full-rank Gaussian noise: 3D allows a finite second moment even with explicitly nonzero axial rotational mean. The tail prefactor collapses the role of anisotropic drift and noise to a stationary origin density and innovation norm moment, indicating exactly which rare near-origin events govern statistical instability. This is a motivated structural classification, not an arbitrary model slice; no broader motor-performance theorem is asserted.
